result.summary: The page appears largely well-formed with no critical or major visual defects. Only minor cosmetic inconsistencies were found.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké card has a light gray image background while the neighboring cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccol...) use dark, photographic-style backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent image treatment (background tone/crop style) across all carousel thumbnails so cards feel uniform.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' section show delivery time and fee but no rating, while the 'Popular right now' card shows a rating (4.8, 500+). This inconsistency may make the smaller cards feel incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding rating information to the 'Fastest near you' cards for consistency, or intentionally standardize the metadata shown per card type.

issues.description: The unfilled heart (favorite) icon overlaid on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image sits on a variable, mid-tone photo background without a strong backing, which could reduce visibility on lighter images (the pizza card below uses a dark circular backing, which the ramen card lacks in the same strength).
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent semi-opaque dark circular background behind all overlaid heart icons to guarantee contrast on any image.
